statement: The pinned Linux xpad consumer handles Xbox 360 controller input, connection/headset-present status and rumble, but this inspected driver has no headset PCM playback/capture or ALSA audio registration. Its wired Xbox 360 USB interface selection is XInput-like and not ordinary HID audio; the virtualgamepad functional 2-out/1-in sidecar is not evidence that an Xbox 360 native wired-headset transport has been emulated.

applicability.scope: Consumer-file absence; XInput/proprietary headset audio protocol details and reference hardware capability are outside this source. The claim is deliberately not that Xbox 360 hardware has no headset audio.
